additional_carrier_contract: Each complete typed logical group maps to exactly one nonempty visible whole word through one fixed GLOBAL INJECTIVE mapping over all constructor roles and payloads. Logical group order and boundaries are preserved; no omitted headers or hidden reset groups. This is an additional physical realization hypothesis, not part of an identified native code.

IDEA001038.claim: No two adjacent canonical typed groups are identical.
edge_cases: FRAME(c) appears once per exact context ID. Empty frames can place FRAME(c),FRAME(d) next to one another, but c and d must differ.
SUBJECT(x) names are unique within a frame and occur before HEAD groups. Across frames a FRAME group intervenes.
Every HEAD corresponds to a nonempty observation roster and is followed by at least one MEMBER; no empty HEAD is emitted. Distinct head keys are emitted once per frame.
Within one roster MEMBER(x,k) occurs once per subject x. Consecutive members have different names even if multiplicities coincide.
Across rosters a HEAD separates members. Across frames a FRAME separates groups.
Different constructor tags denote different typed logical groups even when quoted names resemble keywords or payloads coincide.
IDEA001038.carrier_consequence: Global injectivity implies equal visible words have identical typed preimages. Therefore a visible adjacentXX pair is impossible under this exact realization. Arbitrary word lengths, a different glyph bijection or different source content within the declared canonical domain cannot remove this contradiction.
IDEA001038.prior_native_application: Parent nominates already-known GDT1274 whole qokeedy doublets as the external source-bound premise. This reviewer did not read or recount those native files. If that exact adjacency/group premise is retained, it refutes this carrier realization only.
limits: The source observation-roster codec itself remains valid as a synthetic normalization.
Do not infer that all rosters, all semantic writing, or every physical rendering is impossible.

Allowing homography between different typed roles, grouping several logical records into one visible word, contextual spellings or unprinted scope changes the explicit carrier contract; none is silently granted here.
No actual meaning of qokeedy or any other native whole is inferred.

IDEA001039.countermodel: A schedule starting at tau with one explicit object/context can contain PHASE(1,P),PHASE(1,P) for the same complete profile P. The writer expressly preserves both phase boundaries and does not merge them.
IDEA001039.reader: First phase occupies[tau,tau+1), second[tau+1,tau+2). Both typed groups are identical, but the complete source events differ in ordinal/interval placement.
IDEA001039.carrier_consequence: An injective whole-group mapping may give their shared typed group one wordW and outputWW. Thus the no-adjacent-repeat obstruction from1038doesnot apply.
IDEA001039.claim_ceiling: This is a source-free compatibility countermodel, not a native time assignment, statistical fit, selected duration value, or independent evidence that a manuscript doublet denotes phases.

retained_distinctions: Typed-group identity is not identical to complete context-expanded message identity.
Injectivity is imposed for this one realization; natural writing may be systematically ambiguous under other explicitly defined readers.
No proposal patch, new test, reader pooling, language preference or lexical assignment.

extended_carrier_review.contract: Each logical group emits exactly one nonempty visible whole word. Each typed group may have arbitrarily many spellings, but spelling sets of distinct typed groups are disjoint: one global visible-word-to-typed-group function exists. The selected adjacent pair belongs to ONE canonical document; no invisible document reset intervenes.
extended_carrier_review.proof: If adjacent visible words are identical, the global decoder gives identical typed groups. Inside one canonical roster document, FRAME IDs and subject declarations are unique, each nonempty HEAD is separated from the next by MEMBER groups, members within a roster have distinct subject names, and constructor changes preserve distinct typed groups. Hence identical adjacent groups cannot occur. Multiple spellings of one group do not affect this implication.
extended_carrier_review.document_scope: The absence of identical adjacent groups is not asserted for arbitrary unmarked document concatenations. Two empty documents with the same context may yield FRAME(C), FRAME(C). Membership of the selected doublet in one canonical document is an explicit model premise, not a semantic fact proved by definite spaces, same line or transcription accounting.
extended_carrier_review.homography_limit: Position-dependent decoding is outside this global decoder premise; this does not exclude natural scripts with contextual ambiguity.
